BohrSet.statement: For a type $G$, $\mathrm{BohrSet}(G)$ is a type (in the same universe as $G$), the type of Bohr sets on $G$. According to its docstring, a Bohr set on an additive group $G$ consists of a finite set of characters of $G$ (the frequencies) together with an extended nonnegative real width for each frequency $\psi$, and is thought of as the set $\{x : \|1 - \psi(x)\| \le \text{width}(\psi) \text{ for all frequencies } \psi\}$ (the chord-length convention).
